method: STCD (LLVE-STCD, IJCAI'25), official SDSD-indoor ckpt indoor_G.pth
protocol: unified: video center T=16, 512x512 center crop (eval_lib / seer_eval_unified iterators); uint8 RGB PSNR, LPIPS/DISTS/CLIPIQA pyiqa via score_frames; per-frame -> per-seq mean -> mean over seqs
stcd_inference: 2-frame model: out_t = netG(x_t, x_{t+1})[2]; neighbour from the same 16-frame 512x512 clip, replicate pad at clip end (t=15 uses x_15); input swapped RGB->BGR (official loader swaps the RGB .npy), output swapped back; fp32; native resolution, no 960x512 resize

STCD-12_indexpaired_derived.note: DERIVED, not an official split: pair13/15/21/23/31/33 from STCD-12 (basename == index pairing for these), pair50..70 from L0 (index pairing)

notes: USE L0_SDSD-indoor.clean6 for the Seer comparison (same iterator Seer uses; LQ/GT paired by sorted index).

WARNING: eval_lib.iter_sdsd_indoor_stcd pairs LQ/GT by file basename. For pair50/52/58/60/68/70 the input/ and GT/ filenames are offset (e.g. pair60 LQ 0032.. vs GT 0054..) while content is aligned by sorted index (NCC of 512 centre crop, mid frame: index pairing 0.895/0.912/0.983/0.927/0.984/0.944 vs basename pairing 0.846/0.812/0.700/0.440/0.470/0.860). So STCD-12 numbers for those 6 seqs are scored against misaligned GT (this affects every baseline scored with iter_sdsd_indoor_stcd, e.g. all get ~8 dB on pair68). STCD-12_SDSD-indoor.clean6 is therefore NOT meaningful; STCD-12_indexpaired_derived replaces those 6 by their L0 (index-paired) entries.
STCD is resolution/crop sensitive: pair50 first-16 index-paired PSNR 30.41 (512 crop) -> 26.24 (640) -> 21.27 (full 1920x1080).
lol_inference: L3-L5 (LOL images): netG(x, x)[2] with the single image as both frames, BGR in/out, fp32, full resolution, reflect pad to multiple of 4 then crop (all LOL images are already multiples of 4 -> no padding applied); indoor_G.pth cross-domain
